name: Naval Test — Surface Action Group
description: A friendly Arleigh Burke destroyer holds station in the open Ionian Sea, supported by a friendly RQ-4 maritime-ISR drone overhead, while a hostile Burke sits ~40 km north — beyond the ship's own radar horizon. The drone cues the hostile ship over datalink so the friendly ship can take an over-the-horizon Harpoon shot (cooperative engagement). Two hostile fighters run in from the north to exercise the layered air defence (SM-6 / RAM / CIWS). Spectate a ship from the tactical map to watch it fight.
